subject: SAC-B6 capacity-homeostatic profiles

biologicalReference.citation: Schlegel et al. (2024), Whole-brain annotation and multi-connectome cell typing of Drosophila, Nature 634:139-152
biologicalReference.observation: The study reports evidence for functional homeostasis in the mushroom body through adjustment of absolute excitatory input while maintaining the excitation/inhibition ratio across connectomes.
biologicalReference.engineeringReading: Preserve empirically useful engineering invariants across capacity changes rather than copying biological neuron counts or E/I ratios.

genericProfile.scaleRule: Change dimensions while rounding Active from the base Active/Dimensions ratio; fanout and seed remain fixed.
genericProfile.stopLine: Profile labels and ratios are evaluation constructs, not deployment requirements.

boundaryFixtures.observation: With four local feature families plus a half-budget global residual, Active=4 cannot reserve at least one local slot per family while preserving the requested 50/50 local/global ratio.
boundaryFixtures.behavior: fail-closed rather than silently changing the B2 policy ratio

boundaryFixtures.observation: Despite preserving Active/Dimensions=1/64, configured winners approach the fixed input projection upper bound and the synthetic desired ordering reverses.
boundaryFixtures.interpretation: Active fraction alone is not a sufficient homeostatic invariant; selection pressure relative to input projection cardinality must also be bounded.

b1Interaction.observation: On the same B2 soft-local fixture, B1 family normalization improved the desired-minus-distractor margin for the first three profiles.
b1Interaction.note: This is one synthetic fixture and does not establish that normalization monotonically improves all profiles or workloads.

localVerification.method: A temporary Go module used the same capacity-profile helper semantics and a deterministic reconstruction of the current sparse encoder, SUI feature projection, B1 family normalization, and B2 local+global competition.
localVerification.unitTestCommand: gofmt -w sparseassoc/*.go capacityprofile/*.go integration/*.go && go test -v ./...
localVerification.note: Benchmarks encode one already-prepared anchor through the reconstructed B2 local+global competition path. They are not exact repository checkout, Go 1.25, end-to-end retrieval, or production benchmarks.

derivedResearchInsight.additionalCandidateInvariant: configured or effective winners relative to available/touched input projections (competition selection pressure)
derivedResearchInsight.futureQuestion: Whether effective Active should be clamped or adapted from observed feature/touched cardinality without making input size a semantic importance signal.
derivedResearchInsight.observedFollowUp: Use path-specific selected/post-hash-touched diagnostics before considering any adaptive Active or local-budget rule.

followUp.result: post-hash touched dimensions are now observable per B2 path; the prior total-active upper-bound proxy is retained only as a coarse pre-collision comparison.
followUp.keyObservation: oversized global residual observed winner share is 256/574≈0.446 while graph/provenance/grouping local paths reach 1.0; local low-cardinality saturation is therefore visible separately from global pressure.
